scope: Read-only, bounded inventory of selected upstream Linux paths and match tables. No kernel build or physical device test was performed for this inventory.

kernel_org_release_listing.limitation: A release listing is not a board compatibility test; the file inventory below concerns the pinned master commit only.

limitations: Directory absence is bounded to the named directory and filename queries; it is not proof that no upstream patch, mailing-list series, branch or alternative implementation exists.
This inventory does not claim that every driver is present in Linux 6.12.114 or in every later stable release; exact backport and rebase analysis remains necessary.
A matching family or DT compatible does not prove a fitted chip, successful initialization, firmware equivalence, functional output or owner native-Linux acceptance.
No existing owner acceptance result is changed by this source inventory.
